text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hic! Waaah... I dropped my candy!

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Here, you can have mine! I don't have
room for
it in my tummy, anyway! You
can eat it for me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This is fine. It's not like I'm not trying to
act tough
or anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I mean, this is just my role, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I-I'm so sorryyy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A loud apology echoes through the
halls. I turn
around and see an
overturned cardboard box on
the floor
with its contents spilling from it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aw, girlie! You don't have to apologize!
You
good? Are you hurt anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-no, I'm okay... But... But!
Aaaah! I
need to tidy this all up!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Meisho Doto, your scheduled running
partner,
Opera O, could wait no longer
and has started
singing an opera. Please
come to the track
immediately."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek! O-oh no, I knew I had somewhere to get to! Now I really have to clean this up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't lose your head. I'll take care
of this, so
you just get going!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? B-but, I made such a mess of
things—

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Ouch! What just fell on my head?! Just what the heck are all these notebooks doing here ?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Well, it's no biggie! It'll be like a
little
collect-a-thon! Opera O can't wait
forever, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I'm really sorry about this! I'll
come back
straight after I'm done!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's see... Wow, she wasn't
kidding
about the mess. Welp, time to
get this cleaned
up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For real? Honestly, I could do with an
extra pair
of hands! All right, let's do
this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! All these boxes have been
knocked over
too?! I can't believe how
much chaos she
unleashed in just the
blink of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
How are we still finding things all the
way out
here? Sheesh girl, I'm low-key
impressed at this
point.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You got startled when you saw
something
falling toward you from
above, so you fell into
the fountain? Uh,
well, let's get those clothes
dried first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us work to resolve
the
accidental pandemonium caused by
Meisho
Doto...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. I didn't manage to help you
at all in
the end...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nah, don't sweat it! How did the partner
run go?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It went really well, thanks to you. Um...
I'm
grateful for all your help.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Palmster? What're you still doing
here?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you say you were gonna head out
to snag
some limited-edition goodies
today? Are you still
good on time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Yeah, but it's not a big deal.
They say
they're limited-edition, but
they've done reruns
before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Besides, helping Doto out was way more

important!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Um, um... I'm so, so, so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, you're fine, girl. I'm happy
just
knowing your run went well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I've got free time now, so why
don't we
all go sing some karaoke?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You down, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like you even gotta ask! Let's get this
party
started! Your trainer friend's
coming too, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios

party
started! Your trainer friend's
coming too, right?

text_block_list.text: Consider it thanks for helping me out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's touching how considerate Mejiro
Palmer is of
others, but I'm a little
worried that she might be
putting others
before herself too often.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whaaat, you're gonna pass this up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Welp, there's no way around it if you've
got stuff
to do. Next time, then. All
right, fam! Let's get
going!
